checkAndAuthorizeBimonthlySpending(bytes.details: Requires Roomie MCU authorization 1x every 2 months (60 days). Signature is verified off-chain via MCU PQC key;      on-chain we store only pubkey and enforce time-lock + authorized caller + non-empty signature proof.      Robots mathematically time out projects until entirety done, asking MCU biometric auth every 60 days.

checkFundsUnlocked().details: This is the unlock gate for OBS vault. Vault funds are held as OBS Token and only spendable after threshold.

executeProposalVaultTransfer(uint256,add.details: Enforces weighted voting + robot timeout together. Proposal must have passed majority and deadline elapsed.

revokeAndUpdatePermissions().details: After this tx, updateWallet=0 and isImmutable=true; no further setupRoomieRobotAndLock or updatePatentInfo possible.      Vault withdrawals remain possible via robot-gated flow for ongoing off-grid operations, but governance params are frozen.

setupRoomieRobotAndLock(address,bytes).details: Biometric templates are NEVER stored on-chain — only the hybrid PQC public key (Dilithium/Falcon) is stored.      Templates are hard-locked on the MCU secure element connected to Roomie humanoid robot.      Can be invoked immediately upon deployment and updated once physical hardware arrives, until revoke.

updatePatentInfo(string,string).details: Same revocable wallet as robot key updates. After revoke, immutable.

withdrawVaultFunds(address,uint256).details: Hardcoded rules enforced by robots: funds only for eco-brick (patent placeheld, admin chooses once patented)      + recycled glass tile manufacturing off-grid + future projects of admin choice upon Roomie site verification.      Reentrancy safe: effects before interaction.

checkAndAuthorizeBimonthlySpending(bytes.notice: Robot-enforced bimonthly check-in gating spendable funds to protect token price stability.

checkFundsUnlocked().notice: Checks if bonding curve has hit 5B DAI. Source of truth: ARBITRUM_DAI balance of OBS_TOKEN_ADDRESS.

depositObsToVault(uint256).notice: Vault deposit helper — moves OBS token into DAO vault via transferFrom. Contract can also receive via direct transfer.

executeProposalVaultTransfer(uint256,add.notice: Proposal-gated OBS spend: executes a passed proposal's vault transfer via robot-gated flow.

isFundsUnlocked().notice: Alias for Hemp DAO compatibility — same bonding check.

pqcAlgorithmSuite().notice: Hybrid PQC suite: Arbitrum One native ECDSA secp256k1 + Dilithium/Falcon MCU binding. Biometrics hard-locked on MCU.

revokeAndUpdatePermissions().notice: Revokes administrative update privileges permanently, locking down the contract state into complete immutability.

roomiePqcPublicKey().notice: Hybrid PQC MCU public key (Dilithium/Falcon raw bytes). Biometric templates NEVER on-chain — only this pubkey.

setupRoomieRobotAndLock(address,bytes).notice: Links the Roomie robot MCU public key and biometric template hash.

updatePatentInfo(string,string).notice: Strict restriction: Only the patent name and patent number can be updated by the update wallet.

withdrawVaultFunds(address,uint256).notice: Vault withdrawal gated by: bonding curve (5B DAI) + robot bimonthly milestone + manufacturing site verification.
